open_decision: Whether a lock with no valid owner pid is removed when its age equals stale_after exactly (the laws only cover age strictly above or strictly below, and age unknown).
result_a: true (remove the lock file; this is the ref rule, age >= stale_after)
result_b: false (keep the lock file; strict age > stale_after)
reason: UnknownOlderRemoved needs staleAfter < a and UnknownYoungerKept needs a < staleAfter, so age = staleAfter is unconstrained. Both rules pass every law, and no other law applies when pidKnown is false. The same gap exists for age = none.
